acceptanceCriteria: Each listed call site traverses from / with O_PATH (or an equivalent that Landlock does not treat as a read), with behaviour and refusal codes unchanged on Linux and Darwin.
The unattributed / opens in internal/corpus-mcp, internal/lspstdio and internal/docsbridge tests are attributed to a call.
A confined replay under .github/testconfine shows zero refused opens of / for the affected units, and the selection counts on the V1-0868 five-PR replay are reported before and after.
body:
Filed 2026-10-06 by the orchestrator session.

Found by the V1-0868 lane (2026-10-06, container measurement under .github/testconfine). Five call sites open / for reading rather than as an O_PATH traversal root: internal/flowdocs/files.go:20, internal/testrunner/execute_unix.go:438, internal/testrunner/sql/sql.go:51, internal/cemcandidate/source.go:27, internal/stepverify/safeopen/open_unix.go:88; further units open / without an attributed call. Landlock cannot grant a read of /, so every importer stays in .corvint/unbounded-readers.json and is selected on every Go change (cmd/corvint alone has a hosted estimate of about 759 s). Related: V1-0649 (the Tasks store's own open of /).
title: Test reads: open the filesystem root with O_PATH so about 18 units, cmd/corvint among them, can take a Landlock read scope
